newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI Zachodni shows PLN 43.4 mln Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI Zachodni shows PLN 43.4 mln Q1 profit.

text.p: Polish National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 14 or Zachodni in Poland's mass privatisation scheme made a net profit of 43.4 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997, the fund said in a statement on Friday.
NFI Zachodni, which did not report results for the first quarter of 1996, made a net loss of 14.3 million zlotys for the whole of 1996.
Zachodni said its net assets amounted to 397 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.
From Monday, the 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit are entitled to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse around mid-year.
The units lose their validity on December 31, 1998.
